liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Neal Cassady backed by the Dead// (longer version)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **Neal Cassady backed by the Dead// (shorter version from flexi-disc via Sorochty's cassette)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1967-07-23.aud.sorochty.125462.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 2 songs; 27 min; rated 2.5/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: The first two-thirds resemble a Lovelight jam, with Neil rapping instead of Pig; The recording ends before the full performance of Lovelight is captured [10][12]
- **gd1967-07-23.178201.flexi-disk.pape.andrewf.flac2448**: source not stated; 2 songs; 11 min [2]. Said about its sound: Light de-hum and de-crackle processing was applied, though ticks and warbles remain [2]
- **gd1967-07-23.sbd.bershaw-wulf.5418.shnf**: soundboard; 1 songs; 2 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: The available copy is seriously incomplete, missing significant portions of the performance [4]

## Around the show

- Cassady discusses a Fender guitar and a penguin while approaching the microphone [5]
- Cassady mentions getting the microphone for Pig during the performance [10]
- The Straight Theater opening third night featured Phoenix, Wildflower, and Big Brother [1]
- This recording contains the earliest known version of the song Lovelight [4]
- This live version differs from the fifteen takes recorded during Anthem studio sessions [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1967-07-23.aud.sorochty.125462.flac16**: transferred by Dave Sorochty; source: Source Info: track 1 - aud recording > ?? > CD > wav > flac; track 2 - aud recording > ?? > flexi-disc > ?? > cassette x? > wav > flac [1]. Also: The source file is a copy of Dave Sorochty's unknown generation cassette [1]
- **gd1967-07-23.178201.flexi-disk.pape.andrewf.flac2448**: taped by John Pape Collection; transferred by Andrew F; source: 10-inch 33-rpm flexi disc > (possible direct transfer?) > 7-inch Reel, via the John Pape Collection, dubbed in the mid-70's. [2]
- **gd1967-07-23.sbd.bershaw-wulf.5418.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: The flexi-disc audio originated from a track recorded at the Straight Theater [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by David Seabury Grateful Dead: [1967-07-23 Straight Theater, San Francisco, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1967-07-23-straight-theater-san-francisco-ca-usa/) [14]
- Fan art by SF Rock Posters & Collectibles: [AUCTION - AOR 2.220 - Grateful Dead - Big Brother Janis Joplin - 1967 Grand Opening Poster - Straight Theater - Rough](https://rockposters.com/products/auction-aor-2-220-grateful-dead-big-brother-janis-joplin-1967-grand-opening-poster-straight-theater-rough) [15]
